use_case_summary: Primary: reranking endpoint to score top-K candidates returned by internal retrieval stack
Secondary: offline batch scoring to produce nightly quality metrics and features for model training
Eval set: ~10k seed queries + labeled relevance judgments (binary/graded) from support logs
Goal: improve NDCG@10 and remove regressions across model updates
User surface: in-app help search and automated support suggestions (latency-sensitive)
requirements: Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms for rerank endpoint (end-to-end from call to Redwood to return)
Throughput: baseline 200-300 req/s, need predictable performance during business hours
Top-K: rerank up to K=50 candidates, support per-request metadata for signals
Offline: ability to run bulk scoring jobs (100k+ items/day) with consistent model versions
Model preferences: open weights preferred (Llama-family or Redwood-verified), must support quantized variants
Fallbacks: automatic downgrade to smaller model variant or cached results under capacity pressure
Security: enforce SSO/SAML for console access, KMS integration for key management, audit logs retention 1 year
Data residency: US-only for PII; logs for 90 days unless otherwise agreed
poc_scope: Hosted POC (2 weeks): integrate rerank endpoint into staging retrieval flow; run A/B vs current ranker
Deliverables: A/B NDCG@10 report, latency/cost breakdown, sample logs and error profile
Success criteria: +6% NDCG@10 OR equivalent uplift on product conversion; p95 latency under threshold; cost per 1k queries within finance target
Follow-up: if success -> produce Dedicated sizing + committed pricing proposal; timeline for SSO + KMS integration
